access_boundary: This record represents the GPT-5.1 release whose API page identifies gpt-5.1-2025-11-13 as the fixed snapshot behind the gpt-5.1 alias; the API deprecation page carries no retirement entry for this base line as of review, while its chat-latest and codex variant endpoints shut down in July and August 2026. ChatGPT, the retired 5.1 chat and codex variants, the GPT-5.1 Mini/Nano siblings, later GPT releases, fine-tuned derivatives, and the OpenAI API platform itself are separate service, application, or model boundaries.
strengths: OpenAI documents a dated snapshot that applications can pin instead of relying only on the alias
Two managed serving paths: the first-party developer API with chat, responses, and batch endpoints, and Azure Foundry, whose reasoning-models page names gpt-5.1 with dated feature support
tradeoffs: No developer-published weights are available for self-operation or independent deployment
The generation's chat-latest and codex variant endpoints already shut down in July and August 2026, leaving the base API line as the surviving 5.1 surface
